name: catapult_throw_checkpoint1
description: CHECKPOINT 1, the version known to work: the forward lob that the slow-motion video showed leaving the claw at about 60% of the lunge, 35 degrees above horizontal, with the jaw opening 8 degrees inside the lunge frame (the owner found 8 better than 10, 12, 16 and 26). Do not edit: the tuning variants are catapult_throw_b (more body motion before the whip), _c (the legs and arm jump at speed 0 with the release a frame later) and _d (a deeper rear crouch). Play it with `g2script catapult_throw_checkpoint1 --amount 1.0`. Git tag: catapult-checkpoint-1.
